title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Feelings!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends explore feelings! Bella helps everyone understand different emotions and how to express them. Together, they learn that sharing their feelings can bring them closer as friends!
lesson: Kids learn to identify and express their feelings.
beats: Baby Leo and his friends gather in the playroom. They are excited and ready for an adventure. Bella has an idea to teach everyone about feelings.
Bella shows them a colorful chart with different faces. Each face shows a different feeling: happy, sad, angry, and surprised.
Marjona looks at the happy face and sings a cheerful song. Everyone joins in and dances, feeling happy together!
Bobo sees a sad face and wonders why it is sad. He shares a warm hug, showing how friends can help each other feel better.
Twinkle glows brightly and sparkles. She suggests they each take turns sharing how they feel today.
Each friend shares their feelings. Baby Leo is curious and asks why some feelings are good and some are not.
Bella explains that every feeling is okay. It helps us understand each other better.
In the end, they all feel closer and happier. They learn that sharing feelings is powerful!
They decide to create a feelings game. Each friend will show a feeling with their face, and the others will guess what it is.
The friends have fun playing the game and laughing together. Their friendship shines bright like Twinkle!
